about: The collecta of the formulary “Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed — Mass II” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Lord of mercies, grant to the souls of Your servants and handmaids a place of refreshment, the blessedness of rest and the splendor of light. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
